Dish durably binds it to the exact command, canonical arguments, authenticated owner, and client.run_id, stores the first authoritative success or expected failure, and preserves that result across service restart. Reuse it only for an exact replay after a lost response: the same identity returns the stored result with data.request_replayed=true and data.request_id. Changed arguments or reuse from a different command, owner, or run returns service_request_identity_conflict. Nutrition waivers use the canonical tags [nutrition-kcal], [nutrition-protein], or [nutrition-fat] in the after value, not prose substitutes.
